additional_concerns: node.b66b3e831bb98a12db59dffa omits the transition for existing unapproved applications received before the Effective Date and can therefore return TRUE for changes whose applications remain subject to the existing approval process under d97b56331f41a.u10.1809.

The other seven candidates treat a pending pre-effective application as excluding relief; d97b56331f41a.u10.1809 supports continued processing under the existing process but does not establish an indefinite exclusion after withdrawal, replacement or resolution of that application.

All candidates use an assessment date to implement commencement; d97b56331f41a.u9.1696 establishes 28 November 2025 as the Effective Date but does not resolve which event controls every transitional situation.

The referenced FAQs and existing approval process are unavailable dependencies; these checks establish retention of the selected scope and definition claims, not completeness of the prior-approval determination.
A FALSE result establishes failure to satisfy the encoded relief conditions, not independently that prior SFC approval is legally required.
